name: Optional prisoner's dilemma
summary: Two-player extension of prisoner's dilemma that adds a third option to abstain from the interaction.
rules_text: Two players simultaneously choose one of three actions: Cooperate (C), Defect (D), or Abstain (A). Payoffs are: R for C,C; P for D,D; T to the defector and S to the cooperator for D,C or C,D; L to both if either player chooses A. Payoff values must satisfy T > R > L > P > S. Each player tries to maximize their own payoff. The game is typically played for a single round or for a fixed number of repeated rounds with summed scores.
rating_reason: Specific 2-player extension of PD with abstain option and payoff matrix
